SavingPlanSummary.title: SavingPlanSummary
SavingPlanSummary.description: User saving plan summary document storing plan dates, total target, paid dates list, total saved amount, remaining amount, and timestamps.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase user UID owning this saving plan.

totalTarget.description: Total target saving amount in INR (10400).

paidDates.description: Bounded list (max 104) of ISO date strings (YYYY-MM-DD) marked as PAID.

totalSavedAmount.description: Total saved amount in INR (0 to 10400).

remainingAmount.description: Remaining saving amount in INR (0 to 10400).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the plan summary was first created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the plan summary was last updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

SavingPaymentRecord.title: SavingPaymentRecord
SavingPaymentRecord.description: Individual even-date saving payment record keyed by ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) to prevent duplicates.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase user UID owning this payment record.

dateIso.description: ISO date string (YYYY-MM-DD) matching the document ID.

amount.description: Saving amount for this date in INR (100).

transactionNote.description: Optional user transaction note for this payment date (up to 300 chars).

totalTarget.description: Total saving plan target in INR (10400).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the payment record was created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the payment record was last updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}/saving_plans/{planId}.description: Stores the user's saving plan summary (Dec 2026 - Jun 2027, ₹10,400 target, total saved, remaining amount, paidDates list, and timestamps).

/users/{userId}/payments/{dateIso}.description: Stores individual saving date records (PAID/DUE status, ₹100 amount, transaction notes, and timestamps) keyed by dateIso.
